title.zh: 报章与印刷馆（法第三部分豁免）命令 2011
title.en: Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption from Part III of Act) Order 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption from Part III of Act) Order 2011 and shall come into operation on 14th July 2011.
2. The Minister hereby exempts the newspapers set out in the Schedule from Part III of the Act.
3. The Newspaper and Printing Presses (Exemption) (No. 2) Order 2004 (G.N. No. S 507/2004) is cancelled.
